basic_info.description: Incredible pricing of $636,000 for this brand new spacious and serene model home with 936 sq.ft. of living space! New pricing opportunity is for a limited time. Ceiling heights are approaching 10' and the floor to ceiling windows add to the expansive feel of this home. Kitchens are appointed w/ Arclinea Italian cabinetry, Miele appliances & Dornbrach faucets. Wide plank white oak flooring throughout & level-4 wall finish. Primary bathroom w/ Carrara marble countertop & oversized walk-in shower. Residences at Yerba Buena Island offers a one-of-a-kind living experience in San Francisco. Residents enjoy a 72-acre natural playground complete with trails, parks, coves & quiet beaches to savor the natural beauty of the setting. The Bristol represents a rare offering where the best of the Bay Area is a bike, ferry or short car ride away. Residents enjoy an unparalleled amenity offering w/ a state-of-the-art fitness studio, a monthly calendar of fitness classes, an open air residents lounge w/ fireplace, rooftop lounge w/ BBQ, 24-hour staffed front desks & 24/7 roving security. Free shuttle service connects residents to the YBI/TI ferry w/ daily service to the SF Ferry Building free w/ your monthly transportation pass. Secured garage parking available for purchase.
